messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

The passages do not directly rank signal-generator capabilities for AI, but the raw AI evidence says the relevant AI use case is agentic automation of test planning/execution, DUT management, and result analysis, including automated test-plan generation, smart execution of complex scenarios, lab-management integration, DUT capability maintenance, log analysis, pass/fail/root-cause analysis, and protocol-issue identification [65].
### Most important signal-generation capabilities to prioritize
| Capability | Why it matters for AI-enabled T&M workflows | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Remote automation and programmable control | AI agents need to plan and execute tests automatically and integrate with lab-management suites; signal generators therefore need remote-control interfaces and command sets. Raw evidence states AI focus includes automated test-plan generation, smart execution of complex scenarios, and seamless integration with customer lab management suites [65]. SMW200A and SMM100A support SCPI-compatible remote command sets plus LAN/USB/GPIB interfaces [5], [48]. | [65], [5], [48] |
| ARB and real-time baseband generation | AI-driven test execution needs flexible waveform creation/replay for complex scenarios; SMW200A supports internal baseband generators with real-time coder and ARB [2], and SMM100A includes ARB plus real-time/custom digital modulation capabilities [52]. | [65], [2], [52] |
| Wide RF modulation bandwidth and high sample-rate waveform generation | Modern AI-adjacent connectivity and high-speed wireless test scenarios benefit from wideband stimulus generation; SMW200A wideband baseband supports up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth [7], and SMM100A ARB extensions reach 2400 MHz sample rate and 2000 MHz RF bandwidth [52]. | [7], [52] |
| Multi-source, multi-RF-path, MIMO, and fading scenario generation | Raw evidence emphasizes “smart execution of complex test scenarios” [65]; SMW200A can expand from a single-path vector signal generator to multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supporting up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, and up to 8 RF paths with SGT100A modules [2]. | [65], [2] |
| Impairment, noise, and channel-stress generation | AI-assisted test planning and execution can require controlled stress conditions; SMW200A has AWGN, enhanced noise generation, notched signals, fading, and MIMO/fading capabilities [62], [1], [61]. SMM100A supports AWGN with system bandwidth up to 2000 MHz with baseband extension and notched signals up to 25 bandstop filters [52]. | [65], [62], [1], [61], [52] |
| Signal conditioning and DUT-oriented RF realism | For reliable automated pass/fail and root-cause workflows, generated signals may need calibrated impairments or corrections; SMW200A and SMM100A include frequency response correction, crest factor reduction, RF linearization, envelope tracking, and AM/AM-AM/PM predistortion options [1], [52]. | [65], [1], [52] |
| High-throughput waveform upload/streaming and digital I/Q connectivity | Automated test systems benefit from fast waveform loading and digital interconnects; SMM100A supports ARB Ethernet upload at 10 Gbit/s or 40 Gbit/s and ARB Ethernet streaming up to 1 Gsample with K525 or K527 [52]. SMW200A supports digital I/Q and HS DIG I/Q interfaces, including 40G/50G configurations and lossless connection to other R&S instruments [4]. | [65], [52], [4] |
| Built-in measurement feedback such as BER/BLER | Raw evidence says AI workflows analyze logs to verify objectives, pass/fail results, and root causes [65]; SMM100A supports BER/BLER measurement with 100 Hz to 100 MHz clock rate and CCITT CRC16 BLER CRC type [52], while SMBV100B supports BER/BLER measurement at 100 Hz to 100 MHz [20]. | [65], [52], [20] |
【推論】For AI-enabled test-and-measurement signal generators, the top practical priorities are automation/SCPI control, flexible ARB/real-time waveform generation, complex scenario support such as MIMO/fading, and machine-readable feedback such as BER/BLER, because the raw AI evidence focuses on automated planning, smart scenario execution, lab integration, DUT management, and result/root-cause analysis [65], while the signal-generator passages document those corresponding capabilities [5], [2], [61], [52].

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。

- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
